reviews.text:
Very disappointing compared with non-baby version. This app is of significantly lesser value than the White Noise app from the same seller.

13 of the 17 ambient sound options offered in White Noise Baby already exist in the White Noise app. What is new are Car Ride (Similar to "Cars in Traffic" in the other), Classical Music (Plenty accessible otherwise), Doppler Ultrasound (The main reason I got this app), and Wind Chimes (which I can't stand to hear, anyway, but that's just me).

It lacks the sample mixing capability (but, with so few samples, what can you really do), the ability to multitask while using the app (close the app, the sound stops, whereas the other operates similar to iPod music playback on your iPhone), and the ability to modify certain aspects of the sound beyond volume.

The app is not all negative. If you simply want to leave the device in the room with baby, and don't want a call disturbing naptime, there is a "Baby Mode" option, which disables audible alerts and puts the device in Airplane Mode until you close the app.

It also has some helpful tips on how to care for your infant. These tips, which are appreciated and thoughtful, are also available free of charge on any number of newborn caregiver websites, medical services, and your own mother.

There is also an available "rattle" function, which displays boingy-sounding balls which bounce off each other. When the screen is touched or the device shaken, it sounds like you have candy in your phone. This rattle function disables the white-noise-playback functions, and, possibly, also the sleep alarm and baby-modes. I'm not sure how bubbly-sounding, 2D, bright, shiny, candy-giving balls would help a baby sleep.

And the sleep alarm. This function, as designed, will automatically shut off the app. As implemented, it does this, but, when the app is switched out (eg: Home button pressed), the sound stops, but the timer keeps counting down. And if you happen to restore the app after the timer would have gone off, the app quickly displays a "Timer remaining" negative value, and close itself. Very frustrating.

At best, this app seems like an early version of the more stable and fully-featured White Noise app. I bought three copies, for my wife, mother, and myself. We all use that version well, and I highly recommend you pay the extra dollar for that app.

AMAZING!!!. This app is AMAZING! White Noise is AMAZING! My son is 3 months old but we've been using this since he was about 2 weeks old and I swear by it. When he's unsettled/crying/grizzly (and we know it's not hunger/dirty nappy etc) we put on this white noise app (we always use the Conch Shell noise) and within about 10 seconds he stops and starts to settle. If he's particularly upset, we start it off quite loud but then gradually reduce the volume as he calms himself down. 
We used it when he had his immunisations and he stopped crying within about 4 seconds, despite just being jabbed in each leg!! At night time we use the Sound Timer and Baby Mode which are excellent. The Sound Timer switches the white noise off after however long you set it for, but the Baby Mode uses the microphone in your phone/iPad to know when baby has started stirring/crying and then switches the white noise back on again!! 
We've also used it when he was unsettled in the car or going round the supermarket. 
We believe that when he has a nap, he has a deeper and longer nap when this is on than if we don't play it - it's like it helps him to 'zone-out' from everything else which is going on around him. As I'm writing this review the app is on and he's asleep in my arms!!
Anyway, I could go on, but to sum up...AMAZING - get this app!!
